title: A Bowl of Guoqiao Rice Noodles
subtitle: 考点：特色美食 / 烹饪方式 / put ... into
passage: Guoqiao Rice Noodles is a famous dish from Yunnan Province. It is served in a big bowl of very hot soup. On top of the soup, there is a thin layer of oil. The oil keeps the soup hot for a long time.

When the dish arrives, the rice noodles and other ingredients are not in the soup yet. They are on separate plates. First, you put the thin slices of meat into the bowl. They cook in a few seconds because the soup is so hot. Then you add vegetables, eggs and, at last, the noodles.

Mr Zhang runs a small shop in Kunming. He says that you should eat the dish while it is hot. Many visitors say it is one of the most delicious meals they have ever had. If you like spicy food, you can add a little pepper to your bowl. But be careful, because the soup can burn your mouth!
vocab: Yunnan 云南 · dish 菜肴 · layer 层 · oil 油 · separate 分开的 · slice 片 · pepper 辣椒/胡椒
